# RC Auto Repair Service

> Auto repair · Reparaciones en general based in Round Rock, Texas. Robert and Ulises at RC Auto Repair find what's actually wrong, explain it until it makes sense, and fix it at a fair price. Tune-ups, brakes, radiators, shocks, A/C and tires. Hablamos español.

- Phone: (512) 203-2925
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Service area: Round Rock, Hutto, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Austin
- Google rating: 4.9 from 73 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/rc-auto-repair-service/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/rc-auto-repair-service/book.html

## Services
- Diagnosis & general repair: Reparaciones en general. We find the real problem first and tell you straight what it needs, and what it doesn't.
- Tune-ups: Afinaciones. Plugs, filters and the basics that keep the engine running smooth and starting every morning.
- Brakes: Frenos. Squealing, grinding or a soft pedal: we check it, show you what's worn and fix it right.
- Radiators & A/C: Radiadores y aire. Running hot or blowing warm in a Texas summer? Bring it in.
- Shocks & struts: Amortiguadores. Bouncy, noisy or leaning in the turns, from daily drivers to lifted trucks.
- Tire service: Tire service right in the shop, under the RC Auto Repair Tire Service sign.

## About
RC Auto Repair Service is a neighborhood garage at 2501 Kiphen Road in Round Rock. Look for the roadside sign with the red wrench and the little mechanic: RC Auto Repair, auto reparaciones en general. Robert (Roberto) runs the shop, and Ulises has been the mechanic some customers have trusted for many, many years. Inside it's a real working garage: red tool boxes, road signs on the walls, an American flag and a Texas flag over the bays. What customers say again and again: honest answers and honest prices. Robert asks before doing any work, shows you what he did, and will take the time to explain what's wrong until you understand it. He'll even help you figure out a problem over the phone. Some customers have been coming for years and now send their kids, and local businesses trust him with their fleet vehicles.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you look at my problem over the phone first?
  A: Yes, call (512) 203-2925 and describe what the car is doing. Robert will help you figure out where to start and whether it needs to come in.
- Q: Do you speak Spanish?
  A: Sí. Hablamos español. Llame al (512) 203-2925.
- Q: What kinds of repairs do you do?
  A: General repair: tune-ups, brakes, radiators, shocks and struts, A/C and tire service, on cars, trucks and SUVs.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 2501 Kiphen Road, Round Rock, TX 78665. Monday to Friday 9 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM, closed Sunday.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Calling ahead at (512) 203-2925 is best so we can make room for your car, or book a visit online.
